# Install wedge on macOS (Apple silicon and Intel)

> Untested: these steps have not yet been run on a clean machine or VM.

## 1. Download and verify

Use `aarch64-apple-darwin` on Apple silicon and `x86_64-apple-darwin` on Intel Macs.

```sh
VERSION=0.1.0
BASE=https://github.com/alinganpatra20004/wedge/releases/download/v$VERSION
curl -fLO "$BASE/wedge-${VERSION}-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz"
curl -fLO "$BASE/SHA256SUMS"
grep " wedge-${VERSION}-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz$" SHA256SUMS | shasum -a 256 -c -
```

## 2. Install and run

```sh
tar -xzf wedge-${VERSION}-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
sudo install -m 0755 aarch64-apple-darwin/wedge /usr/local/bin/wedge
cd aarch64-apple-darwin/examples && wedge run -c wedge.toml
```

The binary is not notarized; if Gatekeeper blocks it, allow it in
System Settings > Privacy & Security.
